name: Honey tea
summary: Trà mật ong is tea mixed with honey, poured in a coconut-leaf house at Cồn Phụng. On the town boat the guest stirs in pollen.
origin: The orchard stop on the boat day.
howToEat: Sit down with it in the garden, mid-morning on the town boat. It is not a cafe order in town.
where: Cồn Phụng, or the garden the town boat stops at. Cồn Quy’s longan is a honey source, not a different drink.
seoTitle: Honey tea in Ben Tre — mixed in the garden
seoDescription: Trà mật ong is tea mixed with honey. On the town boat the guest stirs in pollen.
